rows.title: Film Review: New World (2013) by Park Hoon-jung
rows.comment: Park Hoon-jung directs an agonizing crime thriller
rows.verdict_le10: Park Hoon-jung directs an agonizing crime thriller
rows.dek_lead: Park Hoon-jung directs an agonizing crime thriller, which contains the usual violence, anti-heroes, impressive action sequences, and stylish gangsters in their suits, along with the much-loved plot twists.
